title: Workshop place reservation
purpose: Document the requested ability for visitors to reserve a place in a workshop, along with the unresolved policy questions raised by the source.

scope.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

requirements.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

stories.text: As a visitor, I want to reserve a place in a workshop.
acceptance_criteria: Given a workshop that a visitor can view, when the visitor submits a reservation, then a reservation for a place in that workshop is recorded.
Given a reservation for a place in a workshop has been recorded, when the visitor views their reservation, then the workshop and the reserved place are shown.

dependencies.text: It has not been decided whether reservations need payment, an account, a capacity limit or cancellation.

risks.text: Acceptance criteria written before the payment, account, capacity-limit and cancellation decisions are made may not hold once those policies are supplied.

success_metrics.text: Observe whether a visitor can complete a reservation for a place in a workshop and later view that reservation.

open_questions: Does a workshop have a capacity limit, and if so what is it?
Are cancellations allowed, and under what rules?
When is it due to be released?
